record.paper_title: Some problems and conjectures about L2-invariants
record.original_question: Let G be a finitely generated non-abelian free group. For an automorphism f of G, is the associated L2-torsion always non-positive? What is the structure of the countable set {ρ^{(2)}(f)} obtained from all automorphisms of G? And for a fixed real number r < 0, are there only finitely many conjugacy classes of fully irreducible automorphisms f with ρ^{(2)}(f) = r?

evidence.quote: Question 9.8. Let G be finitely generated non-abelian free group. (1) Is ρ(2)(f) ≤ 0 for any automorphism f of G; (2) What is the structure of the countable set {ρ(2)(f)}, where f runs through the automorphisms of G? (3) Given a real number r < 0, is the set of conjugacy classes of fully irreducible automorphisms f of G with ρ(2)(f) = r finite?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G$ be a finitely generated non-abelian free group, and let $f\colon G\to G$ be an automorphism. The mapping torus $G\rtimes_f \mathbb{Z}$ is an $L^2$-acyclic group of finite type, and so it has a well-defined $L^2$-torsion $\rho^{(2)}(f) \in \mathbb{R}$ (in the sense of Lück's $L^2$-torsion theory for group automorphisms). Address the following:

(1) Is $\rho^{(2)}(f) \le 0$ for every automorphism $f$ of $G$?

(2) Describe the structure of the countable set
$$S(G) \;=\; \{\rho^{(2)}(f)\colon f \in \operatorname{Aut}(G)\}\subset \mathbb{R}.$$
For instance, is it dense, discrete, well-ordered, or does it have other distinguishable structural features?

(3) Recall that an automorphism $f$ of $G$ is called fully irreducible (iwip) if no positive power of $f$ preserves the conjugacy class of any proper free factor of $G$. Given a fixed real number $r<0$, is the set of conjugacy classes (in $\operatorname{Out}(G)$) of fully irreducible automorphisms $f$ with $\rho^{(2)}(f)=r$ finite?
artifact.status_search_result: The questions are part of a list of problems on $L^2$-invariants. Existing work (e.g., Clay's paper on $\ell^2$-torsion of free-by-cyclic groups) computes $\rho^{(2)}(f)$ in various settings but does not resolve the general non-positivity question, the structural description of the value set, or the finiteness statement for fully irreducible automorphisms with prescribed $L^2$-torsion. No publication confirming a full resolution of these three sub-questions was found.

status_evidence.title: ℓ2–torsion of free-by-cyclic groups (Clay)
status_evidence.snippet: Computes ℓ2-torsion for free-by-cyclic groups; provides formulas in particular cases but does not establish general non-positivity or the structural/finiteness statements about {ρ^{(2)}(f)} for all automorphisms of a free group.
status_evidence.claim: Partial computations exist, but the listed sub-questions are not resolved in general.
